PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Business Transformation professional with 13+ years of experience delivering large-scale change initiatives across Banking & Financial Services, spanning Risk, Treasury, Capital Markets, and Supply Chain Finance. Proven expertise in business analysis, data migration, regulatory transformation, system implementation, and process optimization. Skilled in partnering with business and technology stakeholders to deliver enterprise transformation programs involving data governance, operating model improvements, product onboarding, and regulatory compliance. Strong capabilities in Change Delivery, Stakeholder Management, Agile Delivery, and AI-enabled business transformation.

CORE COMPETENCIES Business Transformation | Change Management | Data Migration | Regulatory Change | Risk & Treasury Transformation | Stakeholder Management | Agile Delivery | Business Readiness | Process Optimization | Data Governance

SKILLS • Business Analysis: BRD / FRD, Functional Specs, Process Automation, Agile, SDLC, Stakeholder

Management, UAT, Regression Testing, Defect Management, Release Support, Requirements Engineering

Data & Analytics: Data Mapping, Data Migration, Gap Analysis, Data Lineage, Data Governance, Reconciliation, Advanced SQL, Power BI, Excel (Pivots, Vlookup, Macros)

Technical: SQL (PostgreSQL, Teradata, Hive) | Salesforce | JIRA | Confluence | Excel Advanced | MS Access | Python (Basic) | Visio | UiPath RPA | VBA Macro Automation

CERTIFICATIONS • CCBA Training | RPA Developer Foundation | SQL & Python (Udemy) |NCFM – Derivatives Module • Microsoft AI Business Professional (AB-730) – In progress

EDUCATION [ MUMBAI UNIVERSITY ] • MBA Finance, -2012 (69%) | B.E. Computers -2009 (64%)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

➢ Barclays GSCPL Senior Business Analyst – Risk Finance & Treasury

Pune, India Dec-2022 - Present

Project1: Bank Acquisition: Risk Data Migration (Current) •

Leading a strategic post-acquisition Risk Data Migration program involving migration of over 2 million records into Barclays' target Risk architecture, enabling seamless business transition and regulatory compliance.

Partner with Business, Technology, Risk, Data Governance and ETL teams to define business requirements, transformation rules and migration strategy across 120+ critical data attributes.

Drive end-to-end business analysis including impact assessment, data lineage, gap analysis and business





process alignment to support enterprise transformation initiatives. Facilitate stakeholder workshops to align business priorities, resolve data quality issues and ensure successful implementation across multiple global teams. Support Business Readiness through UAT planning, defect management, reconciliation activities and production validation ensuring data integrity and operational continuity.

Contribute to Agile delivery by managing user stories, sprint planning and release coordination using JIRA and Confluence.

Project2: Fixed Income Product Onboarding (Previous) • Delivered business analysis for Fixed Income product onboarding onto Barclays' Enterprise Risk

platform supporting expansion into new financial products.

Defined business requirements and functional specifications enabling automated Risk, P&L and



valuation reporting while reducing manual effort by 30–40%. Supported multiple production releases through data validation, UAT coordination and cross-functional stakeholder engagement.

➢ Nucleus Commercial Finance Ltd Business Analyst (Operations Manager) – Supply Chain Finance Products: Invoice finance

Mumbai, India Mar-2016 – Nov-2022

Played a key role in establishing the Invoice Finance business by supporting product design, operational setup and business process implementation as an early team member. • customer and operational data. • Partnered with technology teams to automate business workflows resulting in 25–30% improvement in operational turnaround time. • Designed functional requirements for business enhancements, internal applications and reporting solutions supporting customer acquisition and operational visibility. • Credit and Technology teams. • Managed end-to-end operational processes including invoice finance, settlements, payments, reporting and risk controls while maintaining regulatory compliance. • Delivered product training, user enablement and process documentation supporting organization-wide adoption. Mumbai, India Feb 2015 – Feb 2016

Led Salesforce migration and business transformation initiatives ensuring successful migration of

Managed Asset Finance operations while supporting business process improvements and digital banking initiatives.

Collaborated with business stakeholders to gather requirements for Tab Banking enhancements and



process automation. Improved operational efficiency by ensuring timely loan disbursement, payment processing and customer servicing using Finacle and FinnOne.

➢ Eclerx Financial Services Ltd Financial Analyst (Barclays) - Capital Markets

Mumbai, India Oct 2012 – Jan 2015

Products: OTC Derivatives, Futures & Options, Swaps

Managed end-to-end trade lifecycle operations across OTC Derivatives, Futures & Options supporting





Barclays Capital Markets. Improved settlement accuracy through reconciliation, exception management and process improvements achieving 98% operational accuracy. Supported UAT and process enhancement initiatives while collaborating with global stakeholders across Operations and Technology.

➢ BNP Paribas Management Trainee (Internship) – Trade Finance •

Mumbai, India 3 months

Supported import/export remittance processing and trade document verification (LCs, Bills of Lading, etc.). Performed compliance checks and assisted in transaction settlement.

ACHIEVEMENTS

Delivered enterprise Risk Data Migration supporting migration of over 2 million records within Barclays' strategic acquisition program. • Improved operational efficiency by 40–60% through automation and workflow redesign initiatives. • Successfully onboarded 30+ enterprise customers during business expansion initiatives. • Reduced manual processing by 30–40% through Fixed Income Risk platform transformation. • Recognized with multiple performance awards for delivery excellence, automation and transformation

initiatives.
